rationale: David brings deep experience shipping autonomous systems (drones, tractors, robots) with production infrastructure requirements, while Charlie has built platforms that democratize software shipping at scale—React Native and Expo now power millions of apps. Their complementary strengths could spark ideas around how developer tools can better serve the next wave of physical AI builders, especially as AI expands who can build robotics software.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Charlie Cheever — David's shipping production robotics infrastructure at LiveKit and Charlie's scaling Expo as the default platform for builders; curious if there are synergies around developer experience for physical AI.
